messages:
orchestrator-bot: nightly-model-sync job 'model-sync-2026-03-08' failed on runner gpu-12, exit_code=1. Logs: s3://redwood-logs/cron/model-sync/1767777777.log

lina: ugh, saw alerts. anyone know if this is the manifest / checkpoint problem again? :eyes:

ben: looking. quick grep of the log shows a checksum mismatch when verifying checkpoint.tar.gz against manifest. snippet:
```
[ERROR] Manifest checksum: 6f2a... expected 6f2b...
[INFO] Downloaded bytes: 120348723 vs expected 120349000
```
seems like a partial upload from the upstream repo sync.

alex: can we just rerun the cron? current backlog isn't heavy and retries usually succeed when the source push finishes. who owns the cron config?

jamie: heads up — infra has a maintenance window starting in ~10m on gpu-12 for driver update. if we rerun now it might get interrupted. suggest scheduling after 02:00 UTC.

lina: thanks, jamie. can someone confirm the upstream push status? maybe the publisher only just finished. ben, can you check s3 object metadata / etag?

ben: checked S3: object checkpoint.tar.gz has size 120348723 and ETag shows a multipart upload ("etag-abc..."), upload completed at 2026-03-08T00:40:12Z which is ~5m after the cron started. so cron started before the upload was finalized.

alex: ok that explains it. plan: schedule a rerun at 02:05 UTC, add a short pre-check that verifies object size == manifest size before starting. I can open a tiny PR for the pre-check.

lina: please do. also add a 3-retry backoff in the cron runner for transient S3 consistency issues.

alex: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123 — adds size/etag check + 3x retry with exponential backoff. cc @ben for review.

ben: quick review done, left one nit about log messages. overall LGTM.

jamie: ci-bot can we schedule rerun? want it after maintenance finishes.

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: `ci rerun --job nightly-model-sync --at 2026-03-08T02:05:00Z --reason "checkpoint upload race"` — run id: 20260308-02-05-176777. You will get a notification when it starts/finishes. :white_check_mark:

lina: thanks — after this completes please paste the final success/failure logs here. if it fails again we'll escalate to the publisher team and open a bisect / retry policy ticket.

alex: noted. also added a short runbook update: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-sync#s3-race-conditions

ben: FYI, I queued a small S3 lifecycle check to alert in future if multipart etags are present within 15m of cron start. should reduce these false negatives.

lina: perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
